column1: # Monsuur et al. 2008's six HLA-DQ tag SNPs for coeliac disease (PLoS ONE 3:e2270,
# doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0002270, Table 3 and Table S1), at their GRCh38 positions from dbSNP
# build 157 (NC_000006.12, read 2026-10-30). The tag allele is the ALT in every row; Monsuur's
# labels for rs7454108 and rs7775228 are on the minus strand and were flipped. DQ2.2 is the
# haplotype T,C,A at rs2395182, rs7775228, rs4713586 (Monsuur's T,G,A); T,C,G is DQ4 instead.
